mapper.select: SELECT omur.member_id, m.member_name, omur.user_id, l.id AS level_id, l.level_name FROM org_member_user_rel omur LEFT JOIN org_member m ON m.id = omur.member_id LEFT JOIN org_member_post_rel ompr ON ompr.member_id = omur.member_id LEFT JOIN org_level l ON l.id = ompr.level_id WHERE omur.user_id = #{userId} ORDER BY ompr.default_flag, ompr.id LIMIT 1

SELECT omur.member_id, m.member_name, omur.user_id, ompr.level_id, l.level_name FROM org_member m LEFT JOIN org_member_user_rel omur ON m.id = omur.member_id LEFT JOIN org_member_post_rel ompr ON m.id = ompr.member_id LEFT JOIN org_level l ON l.id = ompr.level_id WHERE m.id = #{memberId} ORDER BY CASE WHEN ompr.default_flag = 1 THEN 1 -- 默认的排最前 WHEN ompr.default_flag = 2 THEN 2 -- 非默认的排第二 ELSE 3 -- 为空的排最后 END, ompr.id LIMIT 1

SELECT ompr.level_id FROM sys_account a LEFT JOIN org_member_user_rel omur ON a.user_id = omur.user_id LEFT JOIN org_member_post_rel ompr ON ompr.member_id = omur.member_id WHERE a.account_id = #{accountId} AND ompr.lead_flag = #{leadFlag}

SELECT ompr.level_id, ompr.member_id, omur.user_id FROM org_member_post_rel ompr LEFT JOIN org_member_user_rel omur ON ompr.member_id = ompr.member_id WHERE ompr.level_id IN
#{levelId}
